item.title: Let’s Talk Loans, Shall We?
item.description: Who does not want “free” money? Certainly, that won’t be me. Money, clean money is a good thing, anytime… any day. Most of us are drawn to loans mainly because they give us the liquidity we need to get something done quickly, while we relax and pay them off later. But we must be strategic in the way we access loans because the reality is that loans are not free money.
